scope: Windows/Linux HIP text AR; native target verification and state primitives. No draft, vision or HTTP API support claim.

artifact_source.purpose: Same-conversion-family BF16 teacher; does not establish original checkpoint/conversion parity.

corpus.description: First 513 tokens of WikiText-2 raw-v1 test split, 512 scored next-token labels, one token of initial context; no full-dataset perplexity claim.

limit_rationale: Pilot acceptance policy, selected before Q5 measurement: allow at most 5% relative teacher-forced perplexity increase; 5 percentage points mean and 15 points worst-row probability-mass movement; 0.01 nats mean KL bounds distribution-wide loss. Apply independently to all three captures, never just their aggregate. These are explicit bounded-task budgets, not established universal model thresholds or historical measurement cutoffs.
capability: Three exact, greedy, thinking-off replies: 2+2, literal JSON reproduction, Python list length. Both candidate and BF16 must pass the model-owned --capability-check fixture.
llama_rationale: Same Q5 artifact in an independent engine on all 27 short-fixture prefixes; stricter execution budget than the BF16 quantization budget. Full vocabulary, unfiltered distributions; no cross-engine bit equality expected.
